model.neff_source: M0 S2 fine-mesh uniform-oxide FEM teaching reference, not a calibrated foundry waveguide
model.loss_source: Teaching scenario only; no measured propagation loss assigned
model.MMI: Installed PDK default H retained; no added beta times MMI longitudinal span

model.compensation: Analytic per-rail phase tracking; theta/phi offsets independent of truth labels; model-only candidate, not drive voltages

offsets.rule: phi cancels input relative phase; theta cancels inter-arm relative phase; residual output diagonal phases retain powers

model_candidate.scope: Analytic phase-only candidate for this uniform-neff core-plane model; no truth fitting or heater-voltage instructions.

scope: Core-plane uniform-neff teaching replay using bound centerline polyline lengths; model-only analytic compensation. No EC/fanout response, calibrated absolute MMI phase, bend loss/index, process or heater calibration.
